source.roster_digest_definition: SHA256 canonical JSON of ordered [{task_hash:digest(full_task),public_hash:digest(task.public)}] in original panel train order; full task bytes only hashed to verify manifest authorization.

scope.classification_rule: AST/format recognition is separate from manually reviewed public clauses. Manual counts are conservative identified coverage, not exhaustive semantics or executable-check authorization. Unidentified tasks are not evidence of absent obligations.

entry_and_parameter_contract.admissible_static_check: Entry callable name, parameter kinds and allowed call binding can be compared without running task code; do not reject harmless implementation extensions solely for differing syntax.

declared_return.note: Output sections can mix multiple components, prose and conflicting descriptions. Presence is not a mechanically certified type oracle; output type alone is insufficient for correctness.

narrow_named_fields_dimensions_or_fixed_.definition: Named output fields/columns or explicit fixed/input-relative dimensions, row mappings, or stated top-level cardinality. Broader plotting properties and inferred structures are not included.

explicit_whole_input_nonmutation.note: No blanket input-preservation check is authorized. Returning a new value/copy does not by itself justify forbidding every input-side effect.

explicit_output_transformation_preservat.note: These are requested output relations, not a declaration that the entire input object must remain unchanged; the old input_state checker cannot express all of them.

file_delivery_or_path_operation.note: 14 is a public-obligation count, not 14 offline-supported tasks; reads/path mentions alone are excluded. No isolation/network relaxation is proposed.

strict_direct_entry_json_literal_pair.definition: Direct named-entry call with literal JSON-compatible positional/keyword arguments and the entire following output span parseable as a literal JSON-compatible expected value.
strict_direct_entry_json_literal_pair.limitation: The task creates files using numerical/plotting dependencies. Syntactic JSON arguments/result do not qualify existing sandbox execution or all task obligations.

false_positive_and_unsupported_boundarie: A marker anywhere in flattened prose is not a standard executable doctest.
Assignments, dependent names, library constructors, print projections, ellipsis, or nonliteral object displays are not direct literal call/result pairs.
A quoted result followed by prose must not be silently truncated into an authoritative expected answer.
Printed random numerical examples do not automatically justify exact floating-point equality or deterministic-repeat checks.
At least some public clauses have conflicting type/component or behavior descriptions; the checker must keep uncertainty rather than resolve against hidden tests.

existing_implementation.reusable: Typed obligations, contract quotes, conditional applicability, bound execution receipts, unknown semantics, review/calibration and per-version provenance.
current_limits: CallableTask arguments/results are bounded JSON; PublicCase expects exact result or named exception; only repeat_equal relation is registered.
No registered AST signature check, return-type/field/shape predicate, partial preservation relation, or file-delivery/path checker exists in this callable path.
file_preservation model support requires a public baseline file; it does not imply support for newly created files or arbitrary filesystem state.
The existing JSON sandbox qualification does not establish pandas/NumPy/plotting/filesystem evidence support on the frozen BCB runtime.

recommendation: Correct public-format extraction coverage first, with conservative inline segmentation and explicit admissibility review; discovering already public examples is not Research information gain.

Start with a small public-contract adapter for signature/call binding and bounded return-shape or preservation predicates; use explicit public anchors, reviewed argument construction and existing isolation/receipt interfaces.
Add only required typed data/file observation codecs; do not enforce whole-input immutability on mutation tasks, infer random determinism, expose hidden tests, or permit arbitrary checker scripts.

Freeze the adapter and compare scalar-only versus admissible executable-public-feedback updates on the same development evidence and budget; use new task families and multiple proposal histories for confirmation.
Use Research only for a separately identified external factual gap, with a distinct evidence-source label and ablation.
